project.name: llmgw-approval-api
project.description: Approval workflow contract (Chapter-9 9.5.4): submit/pending/decide/ revalidate/revoke with a durable state machine (PENDING → APPROVED|REJECTED| EXPIRED; APPROVED → REVOKED). 批准 ≠ 放行: revalidate re-checks subject and params digest before every execution. Pure strings and epoch-ms stamps. No Spring/Reactor/HTTP.
